stong gsum 'khrug bcos snang srid rgyan mdos kyi bca' thabs lha yi sgron me
item.coloph: zhes de ltar bca' thabs lag len rgyas par bshad pa 'di nyid/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal nyid kyis 'di ltar dgos zhes bka' yi gnang ba thob pa/ zhang zhung sgo phyogs mdo khams khyung po'i tha grur skyes pa sdong (ldong) rigs blo gros seng ge 'bod pas bkod pa la/ phyis bcos 'bum bkra shis sa yi snying po'i mdo yi mchod bstod rgyas par las zhus dag gis gsal byed tshul du a yu d+har dzas bgyis pa mu tsug smar ro//
